evidence.text: WO2020240467A1 Example 7, PDF page 93, Table 2 (data cutoff 2019-11-16): phase 1 open-label DS-1062a in previously treated NSCLC. Investigator-assessed UNCONFIRMED objective responses: 6 mg/kg 5/18 = 27.8% (exact 95% CI 9.7–53.5%); 8 mg/kg 13/34 = 38.2% (22.2–56.4%). 88/95 were response evaluable across ALL dose groups; 88 is not a denominator for either selected dose. No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.

No randomized concurrent comparator. This is ORR, not PFS, and cannot be substituted for AVANZAR benefit or compared causally with docetaxel. Patent PDF p87 [0419] identifies ADC(1)=DS-1062a; p88 cites NCT03401385. Official NCI and current registry identify DS-1062a/DS1062a as datopotamab deruxtecan; those identity sources were obtained 2026-10-22. Two AI roles checked pages/identity/numbers, share a base model, and have correlated error risk. Human scientific reviews=0; no clinical validation; full regulatory sequence alignment not performed. Only this selected experiment, not other examples or ADC(2), is included.

This is indirect evidence: later-line versus first-line, monotherapy versus triple combination, different comparator, and no isolation of the target TROP2 biomarker-positive population. It is not an AVANZAR treatment effect. Source was previously archived as a primary-reader excerpt, not a full paper download; no independent human review.

target.comparison: Dato-DXd 6 mg/kg + durvalumab + carboplatin versus pembrolizumab + histology-specific platinum chemotherapy.
target.endpoint: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) by blinded independent central review (BICR) in the non-squamous TROP2 biomarker positive population
target.population: Previously untreated advanced non-squamous NSCLC, TROP2 biomarker positive, without actionable genomic alterations.
target.success_definition: First official decisive primary analysis reports a favorable statistically qualifying PFS result by BICR in the non-squamous TROP2 biomarker-positive population under the prespecified SAP. Other populations, OS, unadjusted nominal p-values, commercial decisions and delayed readouts do not resolve this target. If multiplicity-adjusted qualification is unclear, adjudication remains unresolved.
